style: Square fantasy RPG ability illustration; elegant hand-painted flat graphic fantasy with clean outlines, painterly highlights, amber gold, burgundy and midnight indigo; single central symbolic composition, no character portrait, dark navy background, readable at 64px, no border/text/UI/watermark.

subjects.o5: A brilliant white crystal focus suspended between two balanced amber magical threads, meticulous stabilization magic.

trade_scene.prompt: Wide landscape illustration for a dark fantasy masquerade roleplaying game trading screen. An intimate candlelit night market bargaining table in an old ruined stone outpost: two anonymous cloaked traders facing each other at opposite sides, open palms exchanging a small coin pouch and a wrapped magical trinket above a heavy worn wooden table. Amber lanterns, indigo midnight, deep burgundy textiles, warm gold glints. Stylish hand-painted flat graphic fantasy illustration with clean confident contours, matching illustrated RPG character portraits, rich but restrained colors. Wide 3:2 composition with table center and readable silhouettes, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Environment illustration, no recognizable named characters.
